verdict.rationale: The README shows a one-line terminal command (`llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`) that pulls a model and runs it, and it showcases a VLM chat "session" with `llama cli`. A hands-on user report confirms interactive in-terminal chat with llama-mtmd-cli, including in-chat commands like '/image image.png'. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of interactive chat features (conversation mode, chat templates, session commands), and independent corroboration specifically for the current `llama cli` text-chat workflow.
